prose.text: The block runs, in order: - the formatter, the linter and the agent crate's unit cases; - the workspace unit layer; - the integration binaries the wheel and the count pins reach; - the E2E binaries (the outer-PTY wheel cases and the ledger contracts); - the rig rehearsals and the rig's inline cases; - the live round (§H); - the whole integration and E2E layers; - the operator pass.

**What is not run, and why:** - No smoke entry. The boot-path reach is the harness boot's stamping `viola verify`, whose relied count moves. Every   stamped harness session in the E2E layer fires it (`run --e2e`), and `binary(cli_verify)` runs that verify over the   fake. `src/run/version_gate.rs` moves test pins only. - No release check: the product graph gains no dependency, and the fake and rig are test-only. - No mutation run (`inputs#I1` item 8).

**Bounds:** - The root and E2E cases wait on events lines under `WITHIN` (12 s), with no sleep. - The rehearsals run under `--deadline 15`. `r3w`'s `--stand 6` is the fake's fire at 1 s plus the turn. - Live: `WS` `--deadline 1200`, as `CS`. `HB` `--deadline 300`: one frame and two keys. `R3W` `--deadline 900` with   `--stand 300`: about 60 s to the fire, three model turns.

**Homes:** - Every test runs under its own home and a test-owned user home. - The live starts run under the rig's scratch at `/tmp/viola-rig-<uid>/` and its private config. - From the real home: the credentials file is read once per start (a 0600 copy, removed at teardown) and   `~/.claude.json` is stamped read-only. Nothing is written under `~/.claude*` or `~/.viola`.   `~/.viola/ledger/stamps.json` is hashed only (`inputs#I3` item 3).

**The live legs' non-priming probes** are the round entries before each start: the install read, the census, the build hash, the host read, the scratch base read, and the start's absence read. Kept frames go to a per-start `<pid>-<ms>/` dir under `target/live-rig/` (research), so a label's ABSENT read is its start ledger holding no line of that label. `WS`'s is its kept file's absence.
**The remove-the-guard controls** are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, not entries. Each reads «holds» only when its case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line.

prose.text: The block runs, in order: - the formatter, the linter and the agent crate's unit cases; - the workspace unit layer; - the integration binaries the wheel and the count pins reach; - the E2E binaries (the outer-PTY wheel cases and the ledger contracts); - the rig rehearsals and the rig's inline cases; - the live round (§H); - the whole integration and E2E layers; - the operator pass.

**What is not run, and why:** - No smoke entry. The boot-path reach is the harness boot's stamping `viola verify`, whose relied count moves. Every   stamped harness session in the E2E layer fires it (`run --e2e`), and `binary(cli_verify)` runs that verify over the   fake. `src/run/version_gate.rs` moves test pins only. - No release check: the product graph gains no dependency, and the fake and rig are test-only. - No mutation run (`inputs#I1` item 8).

**Bounds:** - The root and E2E cases wait on events lines under `WITHIN` (12 s), with no sleep. - The rehearsals run under `--deadline 15`. `r3w`'s `--stand 6` is the fake's fire at 1 s plus the turn. - Live: `WS` `--deadline 1200`, as `CS`. `HB` `--deadline 300`: one frame and two keys. `R3W` `--deadline 900` with   `--stand 300`: about 60 s to the fire, three model turns.

**Homes:** - Every test runs under its own home and a test-owned user home. - The live starts run under the rig's scratch at `/tmp/viola-rig-<uid>/` and its private config. - From the real home: the credentials file is read once per start (a 0600 copy, removed at teardown) and   `~/.claude.json` is stamped read-only. Nothing is written under `~/.claude*` or `~/.viola`.   `~/.viola/ledger/stamps.json` is hashed only (`inputs#I3` item 3).

**The live legs' non-priming probes** are the round entries before each start: the install read, the census, the build hash, the host read, the scratch base read, and the start's absence read. Kept frames go to a per-start `<pid>-<ms>/` dir under `target/live-rig/` (research), so a label's ABSENT read is its start ledger holding no line of that label. `WS`'s is its kept file's absence.
